Updated in cf6c8ff and e0e9434.

The original `# uncompress downloaded file` block is restored in the main function, including the explicit ZIP/BZ2 branches, `ZipFile` / `extractall`, `BZ2File`, completion logs, and the unsupported-type exception. It stays inside each staged source attempt so extraction failures can retry the next mirror.

Multi-file ZIP behavior is preserved: all members finish extraction before cache files change. After successful extraction, files are published individually with `os.replace`, preserving replacement of existing companion files and publishing the requested weight last.

Both `test_download_weights_if_necessary_zip` and `test_download_weights_if_necessary_bz2` are restored using real temporary archives and mocked downloads. Additional coverage checks companion replacement, a corrupt final ZIP member, fallback, and cleanup. This supersedes the requested-member-only wording in the earlier PR description.

The [[latest CI workflow](https://github.com/serengil/deepface/actions/runs/42629909984)](https://github.com/serengil/deepface/actions/runs/42629909984), including lint and repository type checking, also passes on e0e9434.

comments.author: thedotmack
comments.body:
Thank you @Afloat16 for digging into this and for the clear test. I'm closing it without merging, and nothing from this branch lands on main.

Here's why. After tracing every path, the only case this change affects is the 2,000-character work-state row budget: `ruleRowFields` (`src/services/work-view/my-rules.mjs`) drops quotes to make a rule fit. Owner-written rules already start with `quotes: []`, no action in `saveRule` lets the owner clear a rule's quotes, and moving a rule back to a suggestion deletes the field. So "saved with no quotes" only happens because of that storage limit, not because the owner removed the evidence. Main's fallback to the quotes still known on this machine is intended: with this change, those rules would show no evidence at all.

If you want to keep going here, the real fix is on the budget side: make it visible when the budget drops quotes, or store the quotes outside the 2,000-character row so they survive the trip. I'd be glad to help land either one.
